title: Don't change outside variables in render

slides.say: Here is a component that breaks purity. Watch what it prints.
Cup changes guest, a variable created outside it. Rendering it again gives different JSX each time.

slides.text: Strict Mode calls components twice in development, so three Cups show #2, #4, #6.
slides.say: In development, Strict Mode calls each component twice to catch this. Three cups print guest two, four, and six.
The fix: pass guest as a prop. Now Cup only depends on its input, so calling it twice changes nothing.
